Setting up of Postal Tariff Panel
*161. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up a separate postal tariff panel in order to
phase out subsidies on postal items;
(b) whether it is a fact that during the last
fiscal year the cost of providing postal
articles and services continued to rise but
even then, Government incurred a deficit of
about Rs. 1652 crores;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) what steps Government are taking to
stimulate cost effective viable operations in
the postal sector; and
(e) by when such a postal tariff panel is
likely to come in existence?
Issue of Pakistani visa to Indian
journalists
*162. SHRIMATI JAYAPRADA
NAHATA: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL  AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
approached the Government of Pakistan on
the issue of granting visa to the Indian
journalists to cover Afghanistan
developments;
(b) if so, the response of Pakistan
thereto; and
(c) the number of Indian media persons
(both print and electronic) who have been
issued visa?
Paddy and rice procurement in
Chhattisgarh
*163. SHRI LAKKHIRAM
AGARWAL: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state the quantum of paddy and rice
procured by the Food Corporation of
India and other agencies of the State
Government in Chhattisgarh during the
last two years, year-wise?
Telecom services in Tripura
*164. SHRI KHAGEN DAS: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have drawn up
a time-bound action plan to improve and
strengthen Telecom services in Tripura;

Funds allocated under PMRY and
PMGY to H.P.
*165. SHRI ANIL SHARMA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the district-wise and the constituency-
wise amounts allocated to Himachal Pradesh
under the Pradhan Mantri Gramodaya Yojana
and the Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana
during the year 2000-01;
(b) the details of the work-wise amount
allocated togetherwith the works for which
the same have been allocated out of the said
amount; and
(c) the amount approved and spent on
roads, district-wise?
Special Social Security Schemes for
retrenched workers
*166. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of LABOUR
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have evolved
specially designed scheme for retrenched
workers from various sectors till they get
alternative employment;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
by Government to prepare special social
security schemes for such retrenched
workers?
Promotion of Agro and Rural
Industries
*167. SHRI MUNAVVAR
HASAN:  Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of various schemes of
his Ministry for promoting Agro and
Rural Industries in the country
particularly in Uttar Pradesh, Bihar,
Maharashtra and Jharkhand;
(b) the details of subsidies being
extended by Government under various
head; and
(c) the steps taken to promote rural
industries in UP and Jharkhand in future?
Committee to monitoring of IT and
Software Industries
*168. SHRI P. N. SIVA: Will the
Minister of INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
constituted any high level Committee to
monitor and guide the software and IT
industries in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have given
adequate representation to the States like
Tamil Nadu and Karnataka keeping in view
the size of the IT industry and their
contribution to the total production and
exports; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
